what: Hormel makes packaged meat and food: Spam, Jennie-O turkey, Applegate natural meats, Skippy peanut butter, Planters nuts and Justin's nut butters.
customers: American supermarkets and club stores, plus food service distributors supplying restaurants and canteens.
money: prepared meats sold to restaurants and institutions
exports and joint ventures, particularly in China
moat: Brands that have been on American shelves for decades, in categories like shelf-stable meat where there is little competition and the name is the category.
risks: Turkey prices and feed costs swing the Jennie-O business sharply
Revenue has been flat around $12B for four years
The Planters acquisition has underperformed and required supply chain fixes
opportunities: $781M of free cash flow and 16 times that cash flow
A dividend raised every year for nearly sixty years, among the longest records anywhere
Foodservice has been the growing half, where branded prepared meats earn better margins
watch: Foodservice volume growth and whether the Planters business stabilises.
